review: Trace ordinary success and failure, repeated calls, cancellation, and deferred work from each public entry point through the code it delegates to. For each relevant ordering of operations and events, record the starting state, return value, resulting state, object identity, and observable effects. Distinguish work that is scheduled, started, completed, or delivered, and check whether earlier work can still take effect after a call returns. Compare each contract claim with the implementation and related documentation. Check exclusions and applicable conditions, and test whether the same result can arise from different histories before inferring what it means. Preserve verified guarantees and controls. Cite the source for each material claim, distinguish direct evidence from inference, and mark unresolved intent or apparent contradictions as OPEN questions.
